sources.title: todoculebra/coqui-1.5b-v1-q4f16_1-MLC · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A fine-tune of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct by Isla Tech LLC (Todo Culebra, Culebra, Puerto Rico), converted to the MLC / web-llm format so it runs in the browser on WebGPU with no internet. It answers travel questions about Culebra, Vieques, San Juan and the US Virgin Islands in English and Spanish from the app's offline notes.

sources.title: Model Registry and Configuration | mlc-ai/mlc-llm | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page documents the model registry system and configuration generation in MLC LLM. It covers the MODELS registry, the Model dataclass, ModelConfig classes, and the gen_config command that generates mlc-chat-config.json.
